command.js.reason: OMA deny-by-default child environment: mergeEnvironment no longer seeds the result from process.env -- the overrides map IS the language-server child's whole environment. The inherited union meant every name the adapter did not override reached the child, and the denylist that emptied names could never converge (emptying is also not stripping: loaders read an empty path-list element as the current directory). OMA's hardenedAdapter writes the complete allowlisted map; nothing else survives.

Pushed diagnostics are truncated with visible markers and counts (per-file count, per-message length, a tracked-document bound whose drops are flagged into resolved lists on every return path, waiter timeouts included) -- never a #fail. Every inbound frame chunk is reported to registered sinks so the caller's stall window resets on progress instead of a fixed deadline, permanent 'error' listeners on the child and its stdio keep a post-start error from crashing the engine or orphaning the server, and didOpen reports stdin backpressure through the write's own return value so the open loop awaits a bounded didDrain() instead of materializing the corpus in memory.
